thread:
julia: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups checklist for last night's KV latency spike. Need owners for: statuspage copy, customer-facing summary, RCA sharing policy, and recurrence analysis. Keep replies short so CS has one thread to watch.

omar: I can take statuspage + short customer blurb. Will post two variants (consumer + enterprise) by tomorrow AM.

kevin: I'll own the RCA-sharing policy. Question: default share behavior for sanitized logs? Two options: publish sanitized RCA + aggregated metrics by default, or require explicit account opt-in for log bundles. Thoughts?

tara: I'll take recurrence review. Plan: 90-day alert pull, look for clusters, propose short-term hardening and long-term infra fix. Deliverable: slide + recommendation in 7 business days.

julia: For CS simplicity I prefer: public summary by default, full sanitized RCA within 7 days, and raw-ish logs only with explicit customer consent. That reduces churn. @kevin, can you draft a consent checkbox and a redaction checklist?

kevin: Yes. Draft policy approach: 1) 72-hour interim summary (public), 2) full sanitized RCA within 7 days (sanitization = remove customer IDs, IPs, internal hostnames, exact timestamps tied to customers), 3) log bundles shared only when account opts in and signs consent. I'll add a one-page appendix explaining "sanitized logs."

omar: For statuspage copy I propose: "We experienced intermittent write latency affecting a small number of customers. We applied mitigations to reduce impact and are investigating root cause. A full incident report will be posted within 7 days." Short, non-technical.

nate: Minor language suggestion from CS: change "a small number of customers" to "a few customers" — sounds friendlier.

julia: OK keep "a few customers" per CS. Omar, post the final text to the tracker and tag Legal if enterprise variant is needed.

ops-bot: Created JIRA tasks: RINF-1101 (statuspage + customer blurb) -> omar, due 2026-03-27; RINF-1102 (RCA sharing policy + consent checkbox) -> kevin, due 2026-03-25; RINF-1103 (recurrence 90-day analysis) -> tara, due 2026-04-03; RINF-1104 (KV perf patch ETA + perf snapshot) -> nate, due 2026-03-30 (blocked: perf run).

kevin: Adding redaction rules now: redact customer IDs, account-specific timestamps, IPs, hostnames; keep anonymized timelines, aggregated latency metrics, and code-level root cause explanation. Consent wording: "I authorize Redwood to share sanitized logs for troubleshooting under the described redaction rules."

omar: I'll include an enterprise-friendly sentence: "For customers with dedicated SLAs, we may coordinate timing and content with account teams and Legal."

julia: If owners miss the timeline, fallback: Ops posts the interim public summary + statuspage link and notes "RCA in progress". Owners continue to complete the detailed RCA/policy.

ops-bot: Reminder set: ping thread at 2026-03-25T09:00Z if RINF-1102 still open.

tara: Noted. I'll push the recurrence findings into the tracker and flag any accounts with repeated KV hits so CS/AM can prioritize outreach.

kevin: Will add the policy draft + consent checkbox mock to the tracker and request Legal + Security quick review.

omar: Posting final status copy (consumer): "We experienced intermittent write latency affecting a few customers. We applied mitigations to reduce impact and are investigating the root cause. A full incident report will be posted within 7 days." Enterprise variant is in the tracker.

julia: Thanks. Keep updates brief in this thread — paste JIRA links into the tracker so CS has one place to check. I'll follow up Monday if anything is incomplete. :thumbsup:

[end of thread]
